Karnataka Man Murdered in Sharjah, Body Found Dismembered

In July, Alwin Prakash Kunder, a Karnataka native who had worked at Sharjah airport for about 14 years, was found murdered in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates. His body was discovered dismembered into nine pieces inside a car. His wife and son, who live in India, were reported missing, with their whereabouts unclear. A brother said Alwin had stopped responding to his family before the incident. No arrests or suspects have been reported.
